text:
Carmen: Quick kickoff thread for pen-test next week. Need owners for: RBAC ephemeral roles, KMS key justification + grant lifecycle, audit export paths, checksum verification, and retest booking. Short checklist please.
Ibrahim: I can take RBAC + automation. Proposal: create per-assessor role `pt-assessor-<id>-1815001234` with session duration 4h and required MFA. Tag `pt-id=1815001234`.
Noelle: I'll own KMS. We should not reuse prod service keys. Plan: create `alias/pt-evidence-1815001234` in each account in-scope. Use EncryptionContext {"purpose":"pen-test","pt-id":"1815001234"}. Grants only to the assessor role + ingestion lambda. Revoke after window closes.
Grant: Logs: export CloudTrail + app access logs to `s3://rw-pt-evidence/1815001234/` with prefixes `raw/` and `audit/`. Presigned PUTs for evidence with 4h expiry. Require `.sha256` sidecar file. I'll add a checksum verifier lambda that stores verification records in Dynamo under table `pt_evidence_verifications`.
Carmen: Good. We also need a short runbook step to handle assessor asks for elevated read-only database queries — escalate via product-security and record approval in the ticket.
Ibrahim: IAM assume-role snippet to hand to assessors after dry-run:
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":"sts:AssumeRole",
    "Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-<id>-1815001234"
  }]
}
```
Noelle: KMS create-grant example (ops):
```bash
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id alias/pt-evidence-1815001234 \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-<id>-1815001234 \
  --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey \
  --constraints '{"EncryptionContextSubset":{"purpose":"pen-test","pt-id":"1815001234"}}'
```
Grant: Presign generator will live behind the internal presign service. Example we give assessors (ops will run):```python
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
url = s3.generate_presigned_url('put_object', Params={'Bucket':'rw-pt-evidence','Key':'1815001234/alice/evidence.zip'}, ExpiresIn=14400)
print(url)
```
Carmen: Audit needs: capture assume-role events, grant id, presigned keys issued, and checksum verification result. Export CloudTrail to `s3://rw-pt-evidence/1815001234/audit/cloudtrail/` and write a manifest `audit/manifest-<timestamp>.json` listing grant IDs and assume-event ids.
Ibrahim: We'll include an automated revoke job: revoke KMS grants and delete role sessions 30 minutes after window close. Revoke job will run using tag `pt-id=1815001234`.
Noelle: Retention: compliance asked for 30d raw, 180d parsed/alert level. We'll mirror parsed alerts to SIEM. Add lifecycle rules: transition raw -> standard-IA at 31d, archive at 120d.
Carmen: Scheduling: dry-run Mon 07:00, live Tue 09:00, retest Fri 14:00-16:00. Please reserve two 30m retest slots.
oncall-pager: Calendar holds created: Fri 14:00-14:30, Fri 15:00-15:30. Linked Jira: RW-PT-2026-1815001234.
audit-bot: Jira RW-PT-2026-1815001234 (pen-test: RBAC/KMS/audit runbook) created and assigned to Ibrahim, Noelle, Grant.
Ibrahim: Action items TL;DR: Ibrahim (role + automation + revoke job), Noelle (KMS key + grant + revoke), Grant (S3 export + verifier lambda + manifest), Carmen (runbook + escalation contacts). Dry-run Mon 07:00.
Grant: I'll add the verifier lambda and manifest writer to the infra branch and open PR. Will paste PR link + grant IDs here once created.
Noelle: Will post KMS key ARN + grant IDs after creation.
Carmen: Thanks team. Keep updates here and paste PR links, grant ids, and manifest samples. :thumbsup:
